candidates.hypothesis: Repair duplicated/contradictory relational operators in compound IF/EVALUATE conditions.
Expand abbreviated combined relation conditions without corrupting operands.
Tokenize nested/multidimensional subscripts and arithmetic index expressions.
Parse COBOL reference modification start:length without leaking COBOL tokens.
Parse INSPECT BEFORE/AFTER INITIAL and replacement clauses.
Implement INSPECT REPLACING ALL/LEADING/FIRST semantics.
Parse STRING DELIMITED BY with multiple senders and receivers.
Support UNSTRING with multiple delimiters and ALL semantics.
Repair nested inline PERFORM block boundaries and indentation.
Parse EVALUATE ALSO multi-subject WHEN tuples.
Correct INITIALIZE REPLACING category and edited-category handling.
Correct INITIALIZE over nested OCCURS and OCCURS DEPENDING ON.
Honor WITH FILLER without breaking group storage layout.
Preserve shared storage semantics for REDEFINES during moves and initialization.
Correct numeric/alphanumeric MOVE conversion and truncation rules.
Preserve COBOL decimal scale and intermediate arithmetic precision.
Implement ROUNDED and ON SIZE ERROR across arithmetic verbs.
Correct DIVIDE quotient/remainder and zero-divisor behavior.
Enforce one-based COBOL subscripts and occurrence bounds.
Correct SEARCH ALL binary search key and index behavior.
Implement SEARCH serial scan, VARYING, AT END and WHEN.
Resolve static CALL targets and argument passing.
Implement BY REFERENCE argument mutation and aliasing.
Implement BY CONTENT copy semantics.
Bind LINKAGE SECTION and PROCEDURE DIVISION USING arguments.
Correct OPEN INPUT/OUTPUT/EXTEND/I-O state and file status.
Correct READ/WRITE record transfer and EOF behavior.
Fix PERFORM THRU, paragraph return and nested control flow.
Correct GO TO DEPENDING ON ordinal selection and fall-through.
Ensure all declared storage has correct initial state and scope.
